claims.claim: The committed contract binds exact TASK-381 r1 raw bytes and all ten acceptance IDs. TASK-381 remains unchanged and inspect-only; both semantic source paths are declared in TASK-382 scope.modify.

The pair defines 23 bounded obligations with explicit populations, distinguishing conditions and exactly one used proof per obligation. The unchanged VP-02 validator accepts the committed contents against independently derived TASK pins.

Focused test source uses committed documents and existing validators/readers, with rejection assertions for forged pins, incomplete coverage, wrong claims, duplicate or unused mappings, changed conditions, invalid reuse and source substitutions. It also asserts unselected, nonoperative authority behavior.

Documentation distinguishes target and mapping-review candidates, specifies prospective Human-selection prerequisites and source locators, and leaves selection, semantic approval, publication, evidence applicability and activation unestablished.
The committed delta contains exactly the four authorized files, preserving production modules, historical artifacts, existing owners and roadmap state.
